scope: Studio review continuity and safe decisions; product only.
boundary: Actual React components and real services in disposable local PostgreSQL schemas. Fictional preauthenticated accounts; native link/router adapters. No hosted group exercise, email, AI or PayPal call.
beforeFix: An expired approval leaves no sign-in link; refreshing the same unchanged request clears all four confirmations.
journeys: Successful refresh keeps confirmations and the selected decline reason for the same request revision.
Expired approval and decline POSTs keep the review and pause decisions.
Expired GET on an already loaded review keeps the document; first-load expiry redirects before any private review loads.
Sign-in opens in a separate tab while the original review stays open.
GET 503 keeps the review and pauses both decisions.
Different account rejected by actual immutable viewer binding on GET and mutation; original account refresh restores the same review.
A changed saved preference makes the old request stale and removes decision controls.
A fresh request starts with four unchecked confirmations.
A lost approval response plus retry retains one command identity and produces exactly one offer, reservation and offer-open event.
A lost decline response is recovered by refresh, showing the saved CANNOT_DELIVER decision with no new booking or payment.
Native keyboard disclosure and Enter submission exercised.
verificationCorrection: The first local decline adapter passed its action discriminator into a strict service schema. Retested using an adapter that strips action exactly as the production route does; the source API was already correct.
limits: Simulated checks do not establish real-human usability.
No new hosted group, provider payment, model inference or merchant commitment.
Review choices remain in this open document; a full page reload or closed tab requires a fresh review.
